strategy_roster.name: Close Cross Kijun Sen
strategy_roster.notes: The docs state explicitly that the strategy never opens new trades and only closes existing positions when close crosses the Kijun line. Marked non-trading rather than inventing an entry; Kijun(50) would only be usable as an exit condition.

strategy_roster.name: Fibo Average MA Crossover
strategy_roster.notes: The slow length is the sum of the base period and a Fibonacci offset; since neither MaPeriod nor FiboNumPeriod carries a value, a 10/21 pair is a documented-style fallback for that sum. The trailing stop, price-step stop/target and portfolio-based money management are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Heatmap MACD
strategy_roster.notes: The five-timeframe heatmap is compressed to three MACD horizons anchored on the documented 9/26/9 lengths, with the slowest needing a fresh positive cross to satisfy the 'previously not all positive' transition. The optional CloseOnOpposite exit is off by default but the opposite histogram sign still flattens the long.

strategy_roster.name: TDS Global
strategy_roster.entry_long: bars_since(roc(macd(close,12,23),1) > 0 and rsi(close,14) < 30) < 5 and high > donchian_high_prev(high,1)
strategy_roster.notes: Triple Screen is kept: rising MACD(12,23,9) slope plus an oversold oscillator arms the buy-stop, which then triggers on a break of the prior session high (5-bar arming window is a fallback for the buffer steps). Williams %R -75 is approximated by RSI 30 at an undocumented Williams length of 14; stop, target and trailing are in price steps and the symbol stagger windows are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: 5/8 MA Cross
strategy_roster.notes: The documented rule compares a close-based fast EMA(5) with an open-based slow EMA(8) and acts on the crossover, which maps directly. The 40-point take profit, disabled stop and disabled trailing are price points and are not percent fields.

strategy_roster.name: LANZ Strategy 1.0 [Backtest]
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy places one limit order per day inside fixed New York clock windows (08:00-18:00 observation, 18:00-08:00 placement, forced close at a configured hour) with no market-derived trigger, and the DSL has no time or date fields. Marked non-trading.

strategy_roster.name: Dkoderweb Repainting Issue Fix
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_low_prev(low,20) and close <= donchian_high(high,20) - 0.382 * (donchian_high(high,20) - donchian_low(low,20))
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < donchian_low_prev(low,20) or close >= donchian_low(low,20) + 0.618 * (donchian_high(high,20) - donchian_low(low,20))
strategy_roster.notes: ZigZag ABCD geometry is replaced by a 20-bar Donchian structure with the documented 0.382 entry and 0.618 target retracement rates (20 is a fallback lookback). The fib-rate stop/target are ratios of the range, not percentages, so the percent fields stay null.

strategy_roster.name: Fed Model
strategy_roster.notes: This is a macro allocation model regressing equity earnings yield against the 10-year Treasury yield at month end, requiring external yield series and an equity/cash ETF universe that the single-symbol OHLCV engine cannot supply. Marked non-trading.

strategy_roster.name: Gold Scalping BOS & CHoCH
strategy_roster.notes: Swing high/low are taken as the documented 5-bar SwingLength extremes, so the long rule is a break of the prior swing high with a close recovering the prior swing low (RecentLength 10 is a fallback). The dynamic stop and TakeProfitFactor 2 targets are structure-based distances, not percent fields.

strategy_roster.name: Divergence Indicator (Any Oscillator)
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish divergence (new price low with RSI rising over the pivot spacing) is approximated by a 10-bar price low plus rising RSI; the pivot left/right bars, min/max range and hidden-divergence mode are dropped since shifted pivots are unavailable. RSI length 14 is documented, the pivot lengths are fallbacks.
